description: Ask a model or submit a typed decision without sharing its provider key
author: Serg Parf

ask.help: Ask a model with prompt text or an OpenAI chat request

args.name: prompt
args.help: Prompt text, or an OpenAI chat-completions object in JSON; text returns assistant text, an object returns provider JSON

ask.example: agent-bus call '#ai@node.example' 'ask Explain a database backup.'

decide.help: Submit an OpenRouter Decisions request and return the full JSON answer

args.name: body
args.help: Raw JSON request, including state, questions and the decision model; sent unchanged

model.help: Default chat model ID for ask/text and chat JSON requests without model; not injected into decide

base_url.help: Trusted OpenAI-compatible API root; chat/completions is appended for ask, decide uses the same origin at /api/alpha/decisions
